prs.title: Use typed, capped exponential retry delays

blocks.md:
## What and why
Replace unit-ambiguous integer delays with `std::chrono::milliseconds`, then move retries from linear to capped exponential backoff.

blocks.title: Reference demo
blocks.md: This fixture deliberately includes one build-integration defect so the LM finding workflow is visible.

review.global: The typed duration contract and capped backoff are coherent, but the new test source cannot be linked into the existing executable as written.

comments.body: This adds a second source containing `main()` to `retry_policy_tests`, so the target will fail to link with duplicate entry points. Give the new test its own executable or use a shared test framework entry point.
comments.rationale: Both retry_policy_backoff_test.cpp and retry_policy_test.cpp define main(), and CMake compiles them into one executable.
